def even_position(lst):
    """
    Check if every element at an even index (0-based) is itself even.
    
    Args:
        lst (list of int): The input list
        
    Returns:
        bool: True if all elements at even indices are even, False otherwise
    
    Examples:
        >>> assert even_position([3,2,1]) == False  # index 0 has value 3 (odd)
        >>> even_position([4,5,6])                  # indices 0 and 2 have values 4 and 6 (both even) -> True
        >>> even_position([1,2,3,4])                # index 0 is odd -> False
    """
    for i in range(0, len(lst), 2):  # Iterate over even indices: 0, 2, 4...
        if lst[i] % 2 != 0:          # If the number at an even index is odd
            return False
    return True

def even_position(lst):
    """
    Check if every element at an even index (0-based) is itself even.
    
    Args:
        lst (list of int): The input list
        
    Returns:
        bool: True if all elements at even indices are even, False otherwise
    
    Examples:
        >>> assert even_position([3,2,1]) == False  # index 0 has value 3 (odd)
        >>> even_position([4,5,6])                  # indices 0 and 2 have values 4 and 6 (both even) -> True
        >>> even_position([1,2,3,4])                # index 0 is odd -> False
    """
    for i in range(0, len(lst), 2):  # Iterate over even indices: 0, 2, 4...
        if lst[i] % 2 != 0:          # If the number at an even index is odd
            return False
    return True


# Test cases as per your requirement and additional examples
assert even_position([3, 2, 1]) == False   # Index 0 has value 3 (odd) -> False
